accuracy_notes: Built from a wolf: chest 0.85x narrower, neck 0.85x thinner, legs 0.8x thinner, muzzle 0.8x narrower, ears 1.25x, tail shortened to 0.40 m, thinned and hung low (down and back, below the back line, tip easing back). Reads as a lean tan canid with a low bushy black-tipped tail, rufous forelegs, feet, ear backs and muzzle sides, whitish chin, throat, belly and inner legs, a dark dorsal line and shoulder cross. Still wrong or unchecked: the wolf's deep chest and heavy shoulders still show in profile (only the width was narrowed); the head is broad for a coyote and the ears (about 9 cm) could be larger; small ruff spikes remain under the jaw; the coat from above is a fairly even brown, greyer grizzle may be closer to winter coyotes; the gland spot is faint. Check ear size, chest depth and tail carriage against local coyotes.
